item.title: Homepage Search Bar Fixed for Android Users | City of Edmonton
item.description: Homepage Search Bar Fixed for Android Users Date of release June 10, 2025 celia.nicholls September 25, 2025 The latest update on edmonton.ca resolved an issue where Android users were not able to access the search bar on the homepage. Previously, it was not possible to access the onscreen keyboard to type a custom search term, but this has now been fixed.
